name: Go File-Persisted Store with Mutex
description: Creates a Go struct that manages a slice of records persisted to a JSON file, with atomic writes (write-to-temp + rename), chmod permissions, sync.RWMutex concurrency safety, and full CRUD methods.

parameters.name: entityName
parameters.description: Name of the entity being stored (e.g. Connection, Project)

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Path expression for the JSON file (e.g. ~/.paulette/connections.json)

parameters.name: idField
parameters.description: Name of the ID field on the struct

parameters.name: extraDeleteReturn
parameters.description: Optional: extra computed value to return from Delete (e.g. affected stage names). Leave empty if not needed.
